name: Sungas POS Close · variance_amount Backfill
script:
# Fires Before Save on every POS Closing Shift — computes the signed
# variance from the payment_reconciliation child table and writes it
# to `variance_amount`. Unconditional (not gated on workflow state)
# so warning-tier shifts also populate the field.

total_diff = 0.0
for row in doc.payment_reconciliation or []:
    d = row.get("difference")
    if d is not None:
        total_diff += float(d)

# Round to 2 decimals to avoid float-noise churn.
total_diff = round(total_diff, 2)

# Only write if changed — avoids modified_by churn on every save.
current = doc.get("variance_amount")
if current is None or round(float(current or 0), 2) != total_diff:
    doc.variance_amount = total_diff

name: SE Inter-Outlet SoD Guard V2
Sungas MR — Share With Source PM
script:
# After Save on Material Request.
# The destination-side PM already has read access via their Warehouse
# User Permission on set_warehouse. But the source-outlet PM (who has
# to dispatch the goods) has no UP match — Frappe would 403 them on
# direct URL access. Explicitly SHARE the MR with the source PM using
# Frappe's DocShare primitive: gives them read but not write.

if doc.material_request_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # only inter-outlet transfers need cross-outlet sharing

elif not doc.source_outlet:
    pass  # no source outlet to share with

else:
    source_pm = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", doc.source_outlet, "outlet_plant_manager")
    if not source_pm:
        pass  # no PM assigned
    elif source_pm == doc.owner:
        pass  # owner already has access
    else:
        # Idempotent — Frappe.share.add_docshare merges if already shared
        try:
            existing = frappe.get_all(
                "DocShare",
                filters={
                    "share_doctype": "Material Request",
                    "share_name": doc.name,
                    "user": source_pm,
                },
                limit=1,
            ) or []
            if not existing:
                share = frappe.new_doc("DocShare")
                share.user = source_pm
                share.share_doctype = "Material Request"
                share.share_name = doc.name
                share.read = 1
                share.write = 0
                share.submit = 0
                share.share = 0
                share.everyone = 0
                share.notify_by_email = 0
                share.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(
                "Sungas MR Share failed for " + doc.name + " → " + source_pm + ": " + str(e),
                "Sungas MR Share",
            )

name: SE Single-Drop Spawn
script:
# After Submit on Stock Entry — auto-spawn the paired Draft receipt SE
# at the destination outlet for single-drop Material Transfer outwards
# (source outlet → Goods In Transit - SCL).
#
# Complements "SE Multi-Drop Spawn" which handles is_multi_drop=1.

TRANSIT_WH = "Goods In Transit - SCL"

if doc.stock_entry_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # not our concern

elif doc.get("is_multi_drop"):
    pass  # multi-drop handled by SE Multi-Drop Spawn

elif doc.get("is_pr_discharge") or doc.get("pr_reference") or doc.get("pr_reference_new"):
    pass  # PR-discharge SEs have their own spawn logic

elif not doc.to_warehouse or TRANSIT_WH not in doc.to_warehouse:
    pass  # not an outward-to-transit SE — no receipt to spawn

elif not doc.from_warehouse or TRANSIT_WH in doc.from_warehouse:
    pass  # already an inward-from-transit SE; do not spawn again

else:
    # Idempotency: if any Draft/Submitted SE already references this one
    # via outgoing_stock_entry, skip.
    already = frappe.get_all(
        "Stock Entry",
        filters={"outgoing_stock_entry": doc.name},
        fields=["name"],
        limit=1,
    ) or []
    if already:
        pass
    else:
        # Resolve destination outlet from the linked MR (preferred) or from
        # the first item's warehouse hint.
        destination = None
        mr_name = doc.get("material_request_new")
        if mr_name:
            destination = frappe.db.get_value("Material Request", mr_name, "set_warehouse")
        if not destination:
            for it in (doc.items or []):
                # Fallback: MR item's destination warehouse (not the transit hop)
                if it.get("material_request"):
                    mr_item_wh = frappe.db.get_value(
                        "Material Request Item",
                        {"name": it.get("material_request_item")},
                        "warehouse",
                    )
                    if mr_item_wh and mr_item_wh != TRANSIT_WH:
                        destination = mr_item_wh
                        break
        if not destination or destination == TRANSIT_WH:
            pass  # cannot resolve destination — skip
        else:
            receipt = frappe.new_doc("Stock Entry")
            receipt.stock_entry_type = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.company = doc.company
            receipt.purpose = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.from_warehouse = TRANSIT_WH
            receipt.to_warehouse = destination
            receipt.outgoing_stock_entry = doc.name
            receipt.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
            receipt.set_posting_time = 0

            if mr_name:
                receipt.material_request_new = mr_name
            if doc.get("loading_schedule"):
                receipt.loading_schedule = doc.get("loading_schedule")

            for it in (doc.items or []):
                receipt.append("items", {
                    "item_code": it.item_code,
                    "qty": it.qty,
                    "uom": it.uom or "Kg",
                    "stock_uom": it.stock_uom or "Kg",
                    "conversion_factor": it.conversion_factor or 1,
                    "s_warehouse": TRANSIT_WH,
                    "t_warehouse": destination,
                    "basic_rate": it.basic_rate,
                    # NB: do NOT propagate material_request / material_request_item to
                    # the receipt items. ERPNext validates the MR quota by summing all
                    # SE items[].material_request, and counting both outward (source→GIT)
                    # and inward (GIT→dest) legs against one MR item double-counts.
                    # Parent-level material_request_new preserves audit traceability.
                })

            try:
                receipt.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                frappe.msgprint(
                    "Draft receipt " + receipt.name + " created at " + destination + ".",
                    alert=True, indicator="green",
                )
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(
                    "SE Single-Drop Spawn failed for " + doc.name + ": " + str(e),
                    "Sungas SE Auto-Spawn",
                )

name: Sungas DLS — Drop Integrity Guard
SE Multi-Drop Spawn
script:
# After Submit on Stock Entry.
# For dispatch SEs with is_multi_drop=1, spawn N Draft receipt SEs at each destination.
# Idempotent: skips rows that already have receipt_stock_entry set.

if not doc.get("is_multi_drop"):
    pass  # nothing to do — single-drop follows native outgoing_stock_entry flow

elif doc.get("is_pr_discharge") or doc.get("pr_reference") or doc.get("pr_reference_new"):
    pass  # PR-discharge SEs have their own spawn logic in Stage 2

else:
    allocations = doc.get("destination_allocations") or []
    if not allocations:
        pass  # marked multi-drop but nothing to spawn — misconfiguration; ignore

    else:
        # Determine transit warehouse — Sungas inter-outlet uses Goods In Transit - SCL
        transit_wh = "Goods In Transit - SCL"

        spawned = []
        for alloc in allocations:
            # Idempotency guard
            if alloc.get("receipt_stock_entry"):
                continue
            if not alloc.get("destination_outlet") or not alloc.get("item_code"):
                continue

            qty = alloc.get("weighbridge_qty") or alloc.get("allocated_qty") or 0
            if qty <= 0:
                continue

            # Build the receipt SE (Material Transfer, Draft)
            receipt = frappe.new_doc("Stock Entry")
            receipt.stock_entry_type = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.company = doc.company
            receipt.purpose = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.from_warehouse = transit_wh
            receipt.to_warehouse = alloc.get("destination_outlet")
            receipt.outgoing_stock_entry = doc.name
            receipt.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
            receipt.set_posting_time = 0

            # Custom Stage 4 links
            if alloc.get("material_request"):
                receipt.material_request_new = alloc.get("material_request")
            if doc.get("loading_schedule"):
                receipt.loading_schedule = doc.get("loading_schedule")

            # Item row
            receipt.append("items", {
                "item_code": alloc.get("item_code"),
                "qty": qty,
                "uom": "Kg",
                "stock_uom": "Kg",
                "conversion_factor": 1,
                "s_warehouse": transit_wh,
                "t_warehouse": alloc.get("destination_outlet"),
            })

            try:
                receipt.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                # Back-write onto the dispatch's Destination Allocation row
                alloc.receipt_stock_entry = receipt.name

                # Back-write onto the Loading Schedule's Schedule Drops row
                if doc.get("loading_schedule") and alloc.get("material_request"):
                    ls = frappe.get_doc("Daily Loading Schedule", doc.get("loading_schedule"))
                    for drop in (ls.drops or []):
                        if drop.material_request == alloc.get("material_request") and not drop.receipt_stock_entry:
                            drop.receipt_stock_entry = receipt.name
                            drop.state = "Dispatched"
                    ls.save(ignore_permissions=True)

                spawned.append({
                    "receipt_se": receipt.name,
                    "destination": alloc.get("destination_outlet"),
                    "qty": qty,
                })
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(
                    title=f"SE Multi-Drop Spawn failed for {doc.name} → {alloc.get('destination_outlet')}",
                    message=frappe.get_traceback(),
                )

        # Persist the back-writes onto the dispatch doc
        if spawned:
            doc.db_update_all()
            # NB: frappe.db.commit() removed — safe_exec blocks it; Frappe commits at end of txn automatically

        # Optional: message the user submitting for visibility
        if spawned:
            frappe.msgprint(
                f"Spawned {len(spawned)} Draft receipt Stock Entries at destinations.",
                title="Multi-Drop Dispatch",
                indicator="green",
            )

DLS Dispatch → Outward SE Spawn
MR Attach To Loading Schedule
script:
# After Save on Material Request.
# Attaches approved MRs to the appropriate source's Draft Loading Schedule.

if int(doc.docstatus or 0) != 1:
    pass  # only auto-attach on Submit — not on Draft save

elif doc.material_request_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # not our concern

elif not doc.get("hoo_approved"):
    pass  # not yet approved — nothing to attach

elif doc.get("loading_schedule"):
    pass  # already attached — idempotent skip

elif not doc.get("source_outlet"):
    pass  # missing source — cannot attach

elif doc.get("emergency"):
    # Emergency Override — do NOT auto-attach; HoO handles flash-truck logistics
    if not doc.get("approval_reason") or "Flash truck" not in (doc.approval_reason or ""):
        doc.approval_reason = (doc.approval_reason or "") + " · Flash truck logistics — HoO to assign manually"
        doc.db_set("approval_reason", doc.approval_reason, update_modified=False)

else:
    # Determine target schedule_date based on current time vs cutoff
    company_name = doc.company or frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
    company = frappe.get_cached_doc("Company", company_name) if company_name else None
    cutoff_hour = int((company and company.get("cutoff_preliminary_hour")) or 15)

    now_dt = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
    today_str = frappe.utils.today()
    if now_dt.hour < cutoff_hour:
        target_date = today_str
    else:
        target_date = frappe.utils.add_days(today_str, 1)

    # Find or create the Draft Loading Schedule for (source, date)
    existing = frappe.get_all(
        "Daily Loading Schedule",
        filters={
            "source_outlet": doc.source_outlet,
            "schedule_date": target_date,
            "state": "Draft",
        },
        fields=["name"],
        limit_page_length=1,
    )

    if existing:
        ls = frappe.get_doc("Daily Loading Schedule", existing[0]["name"])
    else:
        ls = frappe.new_doc("Daily Loading Schedule")
        ls.source_outlet = doc.source_outlet
        ls.schedule_date = target_date
        ls.state = "Draft"
        ls.truck_no = "TBD"
        ls.truck_capacity_kg = 8000
        ls.vehicle_class = "Tanker 8t"
        # Cutoff timestamps for the schedule
        cutoff_prelim_hour = int((company and company.get("cutoff_preliminary_hour")) or 15)
        cutoff_hard_hour = int((company and company.get("cutoff_hard_hour")) or 17)
        ls.cutoff_preliminary_at = f"{target_date} {cutoff_prelim_hour:02d}:00:00"
        ls.cutoff_hard_at = f"{target_date} {cutoff_hard_hour:02d}:00:00"
        ls.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Compute total kg from MR items (may span multiple lines / dest)
    # Group by destination_outlet so each destination gets one Schedule Drop row.
    drop_by_dest = {}
    for row in (doc.items or []):
        dest = row.warehouse
        if not dest:
            continue
        key = (dest, row.item_code)
        current = drop_by_dest.get(key, {"qty": 0, "uom": row.uom or "Kg"})
        current["qty"] = (current["qty"] or 0) + (row.qty or 0)
        drop_by_dest[key] = current

    # Append one Schedule Drop per (destination, item)
    existing_seqs = [d.sequence or 0 for d in (ls.drops or [])]
    next_seq = (max(existing_seqs) if existing_seqs else 0) + 1

    # Bind doc.name to local var — safe_exec generator scoping quirk
    mr_name = doc.name
    existing_drops = ls.drops or []

    for (dest, item_code), agg in drop_by_dest.items():
        # Check: was this MR already dropped onto this schedule? (defensive)
        already_dropped = False
        for d in existing_drops:
            if d.material_request == mr_name and d.destination_outlet == dest and d.item_code == item_code:
                already_dropped = True
                break
        if already_dropped:
            continue

        ls.append("drops", {
            "sequence": next_seq,
            "material_request": mr_name,
            "destination_outlet": dest,
            "item_code": item_code,
            "qty": agg["qty"],
            "uom": agg["uom"],
            "state": "Pending",
        })
        next_seq += 1

    ls.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Link the MR back to the schedule
    doc.db_set("loading_schedule", ls.name, update_modified=False)

script:
# Sungas · Stock Entry row-level scope.
# Plant Managers see SEs tied to their own outlet (as source or destination,
# or the paired outward SE via outgoing_stock_entry). Privileged roles and
# owners always see their records.

user = frappe.session.user
if user == "Administrator" or user == "lmd-bot@sungas.org" or user == "Guest":
    conditions = ""
else:
    roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": user}, pluck="role") or []
    priv = ["System Manager", "LPG Head of Operations",
            "LPG Chief Operating Officer", "LPG Head of Finance",
            "Stock Manager", "Accounts Manager", "Purchase Manager"]
    is_privileged = False
    for r in priv:
        if r in roles:
            is_privileged = True
    if is_privileged:
        conditions = ""
    else:
        wh_rows = frappe.get_all(
            "Warehouse",
            filters={"outlet_plant_manager": user, "disabled": 0},
            pluck="name"
        ) or []
        wh_names = []
        for n in wh_rows:
            wh_names.append("'" + n.replace("'", "''") + "'")
        user_esc = user.replace("'", "''")
        if wh_names:
            wh_list = ",".join(wh_names)
            # Allow SEs where user owns it, OR from/to warehouse is theirs,
            # OR the paired outward SE's to_warehouse is theirs (i.e. they
            # own the destination of a transfer whose source SE lives at
            # another outlet).
            conditions = (
                "(`tabStock Entry`.owner='" + user_esc + "' "
                "OR `tabStock Entry`.from_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ") "
                "OR `tabStock Entry`.to_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ") "
                "OR `tabStock Entry`.outgoing_stock_entry IN ("
                "  SELECT name FROM `tabStock Entry` src "
                "  WHERE src.to_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ")"
                ") "
                "OR EXISTS ("
                "  SELECT 1 FROM `tabStock Entry` dst "
                "  WHERE dst.outgoing_stock_entry=`tabStock Entry`.name "
                "  AND dst.to_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ")"
                "))"
            )
        else:
            conditions = "`tabStock Entry`.owner='" + user_esc + "'"

name: MR Auto-Approve Rules
script:
# Fires on Material Request Before Save. Sets hoo_approved=1 if any rule matches.
# Only touches inter-outlet transfers (material_request_type == "Material Transfer"
# and source_outlet custom field set).

if doc.material_request_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # not our concern — regular MRs unchanged

elif not doc.get("source_outlet"):
    pass  # missing source — leave for HoO to review manually

elif int(doc.hoo_approved or 0) == 1 or int(frappe.form_dict.get("hoo_approved") or 0) == 1:
    pass  # already approved (auto or manual) — do not re-evaluate

else:
    # Compute total qty across MR items (LPG bulk kg)
    total_kg = sum((row.qty or 0) for row in (doc.items or []))

    # Destination: first row's warehouse
    dest = None
    if doc.items:
        dest = doc.items[0].warehouse

    # Company defaults
    company_name = doc.company or frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
    company = frappe.get_cached_doc("Company", company_name) if company_name else None
    auto_approve_kg = float((company and company.get("auto_approve_bulk_kg")) or 2000)
    emerg_cap = int((company and company.get("emergency_override_monthly_cap_per_pm")) or 3)

    # --- RULE 1: Emergency Override ---
    if doc.get("emergency"):
        if not doc.get("emergency_reason"):
            frappe.throw("Emergency Override requires a written emergency_reason.")

        # Count this PM's emergency uses this calendar month
        first_of_month = frappe.utils.get_first_day(frappe.utils.nowdate())
        used_this_month = frappe.db.count("Material Request", {
            "emergency": 1,
            "owner": doc.owner,
            "creation": [">=", first_of_month],
            "name": ["!=", doc.name],
        })
        if used_this_month >= emerg_cap:
            frappe.throw(
                f"Emergency Override monthly cap reached ({used_this_month}/{emerg_cap} for {doc.owner}). "
                f"Route this through HoO for approval instead."
            )
        doc.hoo_approved = 1
        doc.hoo_approved_by = frappe.session.user
        doc.hoo_approved_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
        doc.requires_post_hoc_signoff = 1
        doc.approval_reason = (
            f"EMERGENCY OVERRIDE ({used_this_month + 1}/{emerg_cap} this month) — "
            f"post-hoc HoO signoff required within 24h"
        )
        doc.escalation_level = 0

    else:
        # --- RULE 2: Standing Agreement match ---
        matched_sa = None
        if doc.source_outlet and dest:
            candidates = frappe.get_all(
                "Inter-Outlet Standing Agreement",
                filters={
                    "source_outlet": doc.source_outlet,
                    "destination_outlet": dest,
                    "is_active": 1,
                },
                fields=["name", "daily_cap_kg", "weekly_cap_kg", "allow_secondary_same_day_run"],
            )
            for sa in candidates:
                if total_kg <= sa["daily_cap_kg"]:
                    # (Weekly cap enforcement deferred to Part 3 — needs rolling window aggregation)
                    matched_sa = sa
                    break

        if matched_sa:
            doc.hoo_approved = 1
            doc.hoo_approved_by = "lmd-bot@sungas.org"
            doc.hoo_approved_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
            doc.standing_agreement = matched_sa["name"]
            doc.approval_reason = (
                f"Auto-approved under {matched_sa['name']} "
                f"(cap {matched_sa['daily_cap_kg']:.0f}kg; requested {total_kg:.0f}kg)"
            )
            doc.escalation_level = 0

        # --- RULE 3: Volume threshold ---
        elif total_kg <= auto_approve_kg:
            doc.hoo_approved = 1
            doc.hoo_approved_by = "lmd-bot@sungas.org"
            doc.hoo_approved_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
            doc.approval_reason = (
                f"Auto-approved under volume threshold "
                f"({total_kg:.0f}kg <= {auto_approve_kg:.0f}kg bulk cap)"
            )
            doc.escalation_level = 0

        # --- Else: routes to HoO ---
        else:
            doc.hoo_approved = 0
            doc.approval_reason = (
                f"Awaiting HoO approval — {total_kg:.0f}kg above auto-approve threshold "
                f"({auto_approve_kg:.0f}kg) and no matching Standing Agreement"
            )
            doc.escalation_level = 0

name: LS Capacity Check
script:
# Before Save on Daily Loading Schedule.
# Validates total drop qty <= truck capacity.
# Warns (does not block) on source-stock shortfall — the schedule can stay
# Draft while HoO decides split/reroute.

total_kg = sum((d.qty or 0) for d in (doc.drops or []))

if doc.truck_capacity_kg and total_kg > doc.truck_capacity_kg:
    frappe.throw(
        f"Overload — {total_kg:.0f} kg on truck {doc.truck_no} but capacity is "
        f"{doc.truck_capacity_kg:.0f} kg. Split to a 2nd truck or defer drops."
    )

# Source-stock shortfall (only warn on hard-lock; don't block Drafts)
if doc.state == "Locked" and doc.source_outlet:
    # Aggregate demand per item across all drops
    demand_by_item = {}
    for d in (doc.drops or []):
        if not d.item_code:
            continue
        demand_by_item[d.item_code] = demand_by_item.get(d.item_code, 0) + (d.qty or 0)

    for item_code, demand_kg in demand_by_item.items():
        available = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Bin",
            {"item_code": item_code, "warehouse": doc.source_outlet},
            "actual_qty",
        ) or 0
        safety_buffer = 200  # kg
        if demand_kg > (available - safety_buffer):
            # Add a message but don't throw at Lock time — allow HoO manual override
            # via 'Confirm despite shortage' pattern (Part 3)
            frappe.msgprint(
                f"⚠️ Source short on {item_code}: demand {demand_kg:.0f} kg, "
                f"available {available:.0f} kg (buffer {safety_buffer}). "
                f"Consider split or reroute before dispatch.",
                title="Source Capacity Warning",
                indicator="orange",
            )

name: LS Truck-Return Guard
script:
# Before Save on Daily Loading Schedule.
# Prevents assigning a truck to a new schedule while its previous schedule
# is still Locked / Loading / Dispatched (i.e. trip not closed).

if not doc.truck_no:
    pass  # nothing to guard

else:
    open_trips = frappe.get_all(
        "Daily Loading Schedule",
        filters={
            "truck_no": doc.truck_no,
            "state": ["in", ["Locked", "Loading", "Dispatched"]],
            "name": ["!=", doc.name or ""],
        },
        fields=["name", "state", "schedule_date"],
        limit_page_length=5,
    )
    if open_trips:
        trip = open_trips[0]
        frappe.throw(
            f"Truck {doc.truck_no} is still on trip {trip['name']} "
            f"(state: {trip['state']}, date: {trip['schedule_date']}). "
            f"Reconcile all Material Requests on that trip before reloading. "
            f"Use 'Force Close Trip' (HoO only) if the truck cannot return."
        )

name: SE Sync PR Discharge Totals On Cancel
script:
pr_ref = doc.get("pr_reference_new")
if pr_ref:
    total = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sed.qty), 0) as total_qty
        FROM `tabStock Entry` se
        JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sed ON sed.parent = se.name
        WHERE se.pr_reference_new = %s AND se.docstatus = 1
    """, (pr_ref,), as_dict=True)
    total_discharged = float((total or [{}])[0].get("total_qty") or 0)
    pr = frappe.get_doc("Purchase Receipt", pr_ref)
    pr_loaded = float(pr.total_qty or 0)
    remaining = pr_loaded - total_discharged
    if total_discharged <= 0:
        new_status = "Not Started"
    else:
        new_status = "In Progress"
    if pr.discharge_status == "Closed":
        new_status = "Closed"
    frappe.db.set_value("Purchase Receipt", pr_ref, {
        "total_discharged_qty": round(total_discharged, 3),
        "remaining_in_git_qty": round(remaining, 3),
        "discharge_status": new_status,
    })
